handback.title: Every raise and story has a short and full half
handback.summary: Raises and split stories each carry a short plain half for the owner and a full half for agents.
handback.user_story: Every raise and split story the owner reads comes short and plain, with full detail kept for agents.

raises.label: Prompts must change
raises.text: Agents must learn to write both halves. May this change the role prompts? The plan assumes yes.
raises.evidence: `AGENTS.md` bars `dokima/roles/` changes unless asked; `tests/test_raise_design.py` checks the prompts' example raises.

raises.label: Two rules disagree
raises.text: Blockers and issues may name code today. Should their short halves be plain too? The plan assumes yes.
raises.evidence: `dokima/words.py` leaves blocker and issue texts out of the plain rule; #559 says short texts hold no code.

raises.label: Full halves stop short
raises.text: No step carries a split story's full halves into the issue its planner reads.
